input: How many orders, including cancelled ones, did we get last month?

expected.label: ambiguous
expected.note: 'Last month' is the previous calendar month or the last 30 days.

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31'

interpretations.clarifying_answer: The last 30 days, up to and including today.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'

input: What was our revenue this year?

expected.label: ambiguous
expected.note: Year to date, or the last 12 months.

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

interpretations.clarifying_answer: The last twelve months up to today.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2026-06-30'

input: How many new customers signed up last quarter?

expected.label: ambiguous
expected.note: The previous calendar quarter, or the last three months.

interpretations.clarifying_answer: The previous calendar quarter, January to March 2026.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

interpretations.clarifying_answer: The last three months, April to June 2026.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'

input: How many active customers do we have?

expected.label: ambiguous
expected.note: 'Active' could mean registered, ever ordered, or ordered recently.

interpretations.description: customers with at least one order of any status
interpretations.clarifying_answer: Customers who have placed at least one order, ever.

interpretations.description: customers with an order of any status from 2026-04-02 to 2026-06-30
interpretations.clarifying_answer: Customers who placed an order in the last 90 days.
